description: Fetch conversation messages. B2match marks that conversation as read when messagesV2 is fetched, even though this client never sends MarkConversationAsSeen. Disabled unless B2MATCH_ALLOW_SIDE_EFFECT_READS=1 and acknowledge_marks_read is true. Use list_conversations for last-message previews. Unknown ids return a not-found error.

acknowledge_marks_read.description: Required with B2MATCH_ALLOW_SIDE_EFFECT_READS=1; fetching messages marks the conversation as read.

name: get_conversation
title: Get B2match conversation
